title: Spectral Optimal Cluster Revisit Schedules for Adjacent-Change Difference-in-Differences under Revisit Caps
banked_reason: The note proves exact spectral frontiers only for T=3, L=2 and T=4, L=2; the general pool-ratio phase diagram and sharp exact-design losses remain open.
gap_reasons: The recorded proposal promises a sharp all-intermediate-cap, pool-ratio spectral frontier, but this node explicitly leaves that object open and the delivered T=3/4 calibrations plus generic SDP characterization are a weaker substitute.

The proposal also promises sharp exact-design losses as T and L vary, whereas this node leaves pointwise losses and G_{T,L} open; the constructive finite upper bound and the T=3/4 cases do not deliver the promised matching lower-bound/sharp-loss result.

The note proves exact spectral frontiers only for T=3, L=2 and T=4, L=2; for general intermediate caps it supplies duality, symmetry, obstructions, and a loose generic rounding bound while leaving the advertised pool-ratio phase diagram open.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived the direct covariance map, exact T=3 and T=4 frontiers, trace and isotropy obstructions, and a constructive general integer-rounding upper bound. It could not close the promised all-intermediate-cap support/certificate phase diagram or matching sharp integer losses; both remain explicit open questions.
tldr: How should a finite pool of clusters be revisited across many waves when each cluster may appear at most \(L\) times and the study needs precise simultaneous adjacent-change DiD estimates? The proposal seeks the sharp pool-ratio phase diagram for \(\min_X\lambda_{\max}(BXX^{\mathsf T}B^{\mathsf T})\), with support theorems, matching spectral dual certificates, and worst-case-sharp integer rounding. This would turn DISC's qualitative benefit from cluster reuse into a certifiable multiwave design rule under respondent-burden and pool constraints, while explicitly limiting the claim to the persistent-cluster component of a specified estimator.
gap: DISC establishes that reusing clusters can cancel persistent heterogeneity in two-wave DiD, but a hard revisit cap makes full reuse infeasible. Rotation sampling and consecutive-contrast block design study related incidence structures under different covariance criteria, and the inspected sources do not determine the direct-covariance largest-eigenvalue frontier with simultaneous row balance, finite pool size, and exact integer schedules.
fill: The project will derive parameterized support restrictions and matching \(Q,u,v\) certificates for the normalized fractional frontier, then prove constructive exact-design rounding with matching lower-bound examples. The three- and four-wave formulas and the five-wave obstruction serve as required calibration points, not as the final contribution.
